newsitem.title: USA: Spielberg, Capshaw have baby daughter.
newsitem.headline: Spielberg, Capshaw have baby daughter.

text.p: Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg and his wife, actress Kate Capshaw, have had their fifth child, a spokeswoman for Spielberg's Dream Works SKG company said on Monday.
She said Capshaw, whose real name is Kathy Sue Nail, gave birth to a seven-pound, 12-ounce (3.5 kg) daughter on Sunday. The baby will be named Destry Allyn, she said.
The baby is the couple's fifth child together. They each have one child from previous marriages.
Spielberg, who is divorced from actress Amy Irving, cast Capshaw in "Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom" in 1984.
